title: It Snowed in July 1816 #shorts #history #documentary
description:
In July 1816, it snowed in New England. Crops rotted, families starved, and an 18-year-old girl dreamed of a monster. All because a mountain exploded on the other side of the planet.

Watch the full story on Echoes of History Channel.

title: The Loudest Sound in History #shorts #history #documentary
description:
Mount Tambora's 1815 eruption was heard 2,600 kilometers away. To this day, it remains the loudest sound in recorded human history.

Watch the full story on Echoes of History Channel.

title: A Volcano Invented Frankenstein #shorts #history #documentary
description:
A volcano darkened the sun in 1816, and in the gloom of Lake Geneva, Mary Shelley dreamed of a monster. Frankenstein was born from a volcanic winter.

Watch the full story on Echoes of History Channel.
